title: Threads were measured sleeping while holding the state lock in a 430-thread test process; cause and production impact unknown
outcome: It's known, by measurement, what a thread sleeps on while holding the state lock in a many-threaded process, and whether that happens on a production host; if it does, the follow-up is filed with its impact.
acceptance: A measured note names what the thread sleeps on at the recorded sites, or says the measurement can't tell
Whether long holds on a running host share this cause is answered from production-side diagnostics that don't open the live store, or the note says why it can't be
If it's a product defect, a follow-up item with its measured impact is filed; if not, the reason is recorded
